mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND subject = #{subject} AND topic = #{topic} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM memory_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND #{label} = ANY(aliases) ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM memory_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND anchor_embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY anchor_embedding <=> #{queryVec}::halfvec LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_tags (user_id, subject, topic, label, usage_count, aliases, anchor_embedding, anchor_tokens, deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{m.userId}, #{m.subject}, #{m.topic}, #{m.label}, COALESCE(#{m.usageCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{m.aliases,typeHandler=com.superprogrammer.common.typehandler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, ARRAY[]::text[]), #{anchorHalfvec}::halfvec, #{anchorTokens}, 0, #{m.createdBy}, now(), #{m.updatedBy}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_tags SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE memory_tags SET aliases = CASE WHEN #{alias} = ANY(aliases) THEN aliases ELSE aliases || ARRAY[#{alias}] END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE memory_tags SET label = #{label}, anchor_embedding = COALESCE(#{anchorHalfvec}::halfvec, anchor_embedding), anchor_tokens = COALESCE(#{anchorTokens}, anchor_tokens), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
